all.name: Captain America
all.description: Enhanced by the Super-Soldier Serum, Steven "Steve" Rogers uses his Vibranium shield and extensive combat training to confront any threat to justice. When Captain America rallies his troops, a wave of courage sweeps across the battlefield!

item.name: Sentinel Strike
item.description: Get up close to strike enemies. Landing the second hit enables a shield throw that can ricochet four times.

additional_fields.Damage: Melee Attack Damage: 40, Flying Shield Damage: 45
additional_fields.Special_Effect: Automatically target enemies near the crosshair
additional_fields.Attack_Interval: Melee 1st Hit: 0.4s, Melee 2nd Hit: 0.5s, Flying Shield 1st Hit: 0.5s, Flying Shield 2nd Hit: 0.57s

item.name: Liberty Rush
item.description: Raise the shield and charge forward.

item.name: Living Legend
item.description: Raise the shield to deflect incoming <Orange>Projectiles</>, sending them ricocheting in random directions.

item.name: Leading Dash
item.description: Boost speed and enable <Orange>Fearless Leap</> to leap into the air.

item.name: Fearless Leap
item.description: Leap high into the air ahead, enabling <Orange>Super-Soldier Slam</>.

item.name: Super-soldier Slam
item.description: Slam down from the sky onto the targeted area, <Debuff>Launching Up</> enemies.

item.name: Vibranium Energy Saw
item.description: Hurl the energy-charged shield to strike enemies in a path.

additional_fields.Damage: Start at 70, with a 20% reduction for each ricochet

item.name: Freedom Charge
item.description: Shield held high, carve a path forward, granting both himself and allies along the path continuous <Buff>Bonus Health</> and <Buff>Movement Boosts</>. Allies also gain Ultimate Ability Charge Acceleration. Using <Orange>Living Legend</> and <Orange>Leading Dash</> while this ability is active can <Debuff>Launch Up</> enemies.

additional_fields.Range: A spherical spell field with a 4m radius enveloping the caster, and a spell area with a width of 4m along the path
additional_fields.Movement_Boost: Grant a 30% Movement Boost to both yourself and your allies
additional_fields.Special_Effect: Allies within its path gain a 30% boost to Ultimate Energy charge efficiency
additional_fields.Health_Recovery_Rate: Cast to gain 150 Bonus Health and grant allies 100 Bonus Health. Every second afterward, gain 100 Bonus Health and grant allies 60 Bonus Health

item.name: Charged Aegis
item.description: Thor infuses <Orange>Thorforce</> into {101500}{000003}{102200}, granting them an electrifying enhancement. {101501}{102201}

item.name: Captain's Spirit
item.description: Inspired by Captain America's resolve, Winter Soldier can leap to the aid of a designated ally, slamming the ground with his mechanical arm to damage nearby foes and grant <Buff>Bonus Health</> to allies within range. Captain America and Winter Soldier can interact with each other once both parties confirm. The duo then collides and unleashes a shockwave that damages and <Debuff>slows</> enemies.
